use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: The primary actor (Customer) wants to view the history of a specific product item, including its auction status (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed), dates/times, bid counts, and winning bidder information.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The primary actor (Customer) wants to view the history of a specific product item, including its auction status (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed), dates/times, bid counts, and winning bidder information.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer views the auction history of a specific product item and sees each auction's status (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed), the relevant dates/times, bid counts, and winning bidder information; a live auction is shown as Active, while a past auction shows its closing date/time.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer needs to view the current and past auction status of a specific product item.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer can see the product item's current and past auction status, including date/time information, bid counts, and winning bidder information.
in_scope_actions: View auction history for a specific product item
View auction status category (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed)
View date/time information (Active for live auctions, closing date/time for past auctions)
View bid counts and winning bidder information
excluded_adjacent_actions: Checkout or payment for won items
variant_dimensions: The specific product item being reviewed
Auction status category (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed)
Current/live versus past/closed auction display information

claims.content: Customer
The Customer initiates the auction status view for a specific product item by entering the Product ID and clicking “Go.”
The system displays the search results for the product item in two sections: a top product summary section and a bottom auction history section.
The top product summary section shows Product ID, Description, Type, Cost, Price, Thumbnail Image, Auction History stats, Buyer Name, Available Quantities, and Active Date.
The bottom auction history section lists each auction record with Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount, High Bid, Number of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.
The Customer selects 'Bid History' from the results list to view the detailed bid history.

The system displays the bid history section, including the item's closing date/time (or 'Active' if live), auction sequence numbers, product ID (SKU), the customer's last bid, their SmartBid (max bid), and the winning bid regardless of who placed it.
Diverges from Step 5: The bid history page includes a link to 'Recently Ended Auctions'; if the Customer clicks this link, the system shows 24 hours' worth of recently ended auction history.

missing_aspects: The specific trigger condition or navigation action that initiates the display of the full bid history (Step 5) is not explicitly defined in the cited evidence.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 1: When the Customer's search for the specific product item returns no matches (No Results Found), the system displays a 'No Results' page. The page includes a 'Search Tips' section advising the Customer to check for typos/misspellings, remove unnecessary words like 'and', 'the', or 'a', try plural and singular forms of the word, use fewer or more generic keywords, and contact support if the tips fail.
The system displays the specified SKU's auction history in two sections: a top product summary section and a bottom auction history section.

The top product summary section displays Product ID, Short 'On-Air' Description, Product Type, Unit Cost, P1 Price, Thumbnail Image, Auction History stats, Buyer's Name, Auction/Red/White Available Quantity, and Active Date.

The bottom auction history section lists each auction record on a separate line with Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount (Opening Bid), High Bid, Number of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.

[trigger_preconditions_coverage] Preconditions is empty, but the Trigger requires the Customer to enter a Product ID for a specific product item. To initiate the auction status view, the Customer must already have/know a valid Product ID and the product item must exist in the system; otherwise the Trigger cannot lead to the Main Flow's successful display of that item's auction status.
